swiftlet.flamingo_lightcones

Functions

flamingo_box_resolution

Find the box size / resolution label of a FLAMINGO simulation from a path to the simulation's data.

flamingo_shell_redshift_file

Fetch redshift shell paths.

Full reference

swiftlet.flamingo_lightcones.flamingo_box_resolution(path)[source]

Find the box size / resolution label of a FLAMINGO simulation from a path to the simulation’s data.

Returns the label, e.g. “/cosma8/data/dp004/flamingo/Runs/L1000N1800/HYDRO_FIDUCIAL/data/products..” -> “L1000N1800”

Raises ValueError if none (or more than one different one) is found.

Parameters:

path (str) – path to the simulation data

swiftlet.flamingo_lightcones.flamingo_shell_redshift_file(box, download=True)[source]

Fetch redshift shell paths.

Returns the absolute path to the FLAMINGO shell redshifts .txt file for the 1000 Mpc (“L1”) or 2800 Mpc (“L2p8”) box sidelength simulations.

Checks, in order:

  1. the L1_REDSHIFTS_FILENAME / L2P8_REDSHIFTS_FILENAME environment variable

  2. <environment>/share/swiftlet/redshifts/<file>, where swiftlet-configure downloads the files to

  3. ~/.cache/swiftlet/redshifts/<file>, used when the environment can’t be written to

  4. <repo>/data/redshifts/<file> (only when called from inside the package, e.g. an editable install)

If none exist and download is True, the files are downloaded (see config.download_shell_redshifts). Raises FileNotFoundError if the file can’t be found or downloaded.

Parameters:

  • box (str) – simulation box, “L1” or “L2p8”

  • download (bool) – If True, download the files when they can’t be found
